thread:
Maya: quick question about /generate behavior when we cut the new response shape — if a client doesn't send Accept-Version, will they get the new shape immediately or is there a compatibility fallback?
Evan: good one. TL;DR: absent Accept-Version -> route-level default is applied. We plan to change the default to the new shape at deprecation flip, so clients without a version header will see the new output once we flip.
Priya: ugh. so SDK users who upgrade but don't set the header could break. Do SDKs set a pinned header automatically today?
Evan: SDKs currently do not attach a pinned version header by default. We're planning two mitigation steps: 1) SDK will add a `X-Client-Pinned-Version` equal to the version bundled when the SDK was released, and 2) we will emit a deprecation warning in responses for 8 weeks prior (via `Warning` response header).
Maya: is there a recommended header name for teams to use to pin model+schema? We need something machine-readable we can document.
Evan: propose `Accept-Version: model-id@v{semver}` for server negotiation. example: `Accept-Version: rwd-llama2@v1.2`. For legacy pinning we also support `X-Model-Bind: <model-id>` for now.
Priya: can you share the curl example so I can add it to SDK quickstart?
Evan: sure — copy paste: ```\ncurl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n     -H "Accept-Version: rwd-llama2@v1.2" \n     -d '{"input":"hello"}' \n     https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate\n```
Maya: thanks. how long is the compatibility window? product asked for a concrete timeline to include in customer comms.
Sam: product plan is: 12-week deprecation window from initial deprecation announcement. Weeks 1-8: warnings and migration docs; week 9: gradual traffic flip for unpinned default (canary -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%) over two weeks; week 11-12: enforcement and final removal of v1 default route. We'll publish scheduled dates in the next 48h.
Maya: ok — so to be safe, clients should set `Accept-Version` before week 9. Any automated rollbacks?
Evan: runtime supports automatic fallback to a compatible variant if the requested model is unavailable, controlled by `X-Fallback-Policy`. Values: `allow-compatible` (default) or `strict`. If `strict`, we return 409 when the exact variant isn't available. We will include a `X-Fallback-Applied: true` header when fallback happens.
Priya: perfect. SDK can expose a `compatMode` option mapping to `X-Fallback-Policy`. We'll also log warnings when `X-Fallback-Applied` appears.
oncall-bot: Deploy note: canary rollout scheduled for 1945679800 UTC -> watch /deploys and /alerts. (automated)
Maya: last thing — response shape change: we plan to rename `tokens` -> `choices.tokens` and add `meta.latency_ms`. Example diffs would help. Evan, can you paste minimal before/after?
Evan: Before: ```json\n{\n  "id":"resp_123",\n  "tokens":["hello","world"],\n  "model":"rwd-llama2"\n}\n``` After: ```json\n{\n  "id":"resp_123",\n  "choices":[{ "tokens":["hello","world"], "index":0 }],\n  "model":"rwd-llama2",\n  "meta":{ "latency_ms":42 }\n}\n```
Sam: nice and clear. I'll draft the customer email and include migration snippets. Can someone own the SDK change (add header + compat option)?
Priya: I'll take the SDK work. ETA: PR by EOD Friday.
Maya: I'll add runtime docs for `Accept-Version`, `X-Fallback-Policy`, and the `Warning` header behavior. PR Monday.
Evan: I'll land the `X-Fallback-Applied` header and server-side warning text.
Sam: thanks all — I'll coordinate comms and set the 48h publish window. :thumbsup:
